Settings menuOn the side panel, you can now see a variety of game settings. You can also tap the all settings button to see all available settings. Talk to the Gielinor Guide to continue.
Gielinor Guide
Looks like you're making good progress! The menu you've just opened is one of many. You'll learn about the rest as you progress through the tutorial.
Gielinor Guide
Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!
It's time to meet your first instructor. To continue, all you need to do is tap on the door. It's indicated by a flashing yellow arrow. Remember, you can swipe across the screen to rotate the camera.
Moving aroundFollow the path to find the next instructor. Tapping on the ground will walk you to that point. You can also move around by tapping a point on the minimap in the top right corner. Talk to the survival expert to continue the tutorial.
Survival Expert
Hello there, newcomer. My name is Brynna. My job is to teach you about the skills you can use to survive in this world.
Survival Expert
The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
The survival expert gives you a small fishing net.
You've been given an item To view the item you've been given, you'll need to open your inventory. To do so, tap on the flashing backpack icon to the right hand side of your screen.
FishingThis is your inventory. You can view all of your items here, including the net you've just been given. Let's use it to catch some shrimp. To start fishing, just tap on the sparkling fishing spot, indicated by the flashing arrow.
Survival Expert
Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
Please waitYour character is now attempting to catch some shrimp. Sit back for a moment while he does all the hard work.

You've gained some experienceTap on the flashing bar graph icon near the inventory button to see your skills menu.
Survival Expert
Hello again. You should take a look at that menu before we continue.
Survival Expert
Next up you need to make a fire. First, you'll need to cut down a tree to get some logs.
Please waitYour character is now attempting to cut down the tree. Sit back for a moment while he does all the hard work.
You manage to cut some logs.
FiremakingNow that you have some logs, it's time to light a fire. First, tap on the tinderbox in your inventory. Then, with the tinderbox highlighted, tap on the logs to use the tinderbox on them.
Survival Expert
Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire.
Please waitYour character is now attempting to light a fire. This should only take a few seconds.
CookingNow it's time to get cooking. To do so, tap on the shrimp in your inventory. Then, with the shrimp highlighted, tap on a fire to cook them.
Survival Expert
Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. All you need to do is use them on a fire.
Please waitYour character is now attempting to cook some shrimp. This will only take a few seconds.

You manage to cook some shrimp.

Hello there.

Player
Interesting. So what brings you to Lumbridge?
Veos
I'm here on a bit of a hunt. The hunt for treasure. Back in my home of Great Kourend, I came across a scroll. I believe it will lead me to something of great value.
Veos
Alas, I've hit a bit of a blocker. The scroll has led me here but as I don't really know the area, I'm not sure what to do next.
Can I help?
Veos

Hello.

Dialogue 5
Player
Hello.

Player
I can imagine.
(End of dialogue)

(End of dialogue)

So how's life as a pirate?
'Betty' B.Boppin
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
Player
I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
'Betty' B.Boppin
What does that entail then?
Player
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
'Betty' B.Boppin
So how's that life?
Player
Can't complain, can't complain...
'Betty' B.Boppin
Well, there you go.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hello.
Player
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
'Betty' B.Boppin
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
Player
More info than I wanted, thanks!
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hello.
'Betty' B.Boppin
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
Player
No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
'Betty' B.Boppin
Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
Player
Why, what do they usually look like?
'Betty' B.Boppin
Erm... I've never actually met one...
Player
Okay then...
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hello.
'Betty' B.Boppin
Hello to you too.
Player
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
'Betty' B.Boppin
Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
'Betty' B.Boppin
Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
Player
Oh. Okay. Sorry.
(End of dialogue)

You winning?

Player
And now?
'Gummy'
Best of a hundred and one.
(End of dialogue)

Wooden fingers?

(End of dialogue)

1v1 Tournament Guide
Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in 1v1 Tournaments? We organise ranked Tournaments here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Tournaments.
Select an Option
What's a 1v1 Tournament?
Player
What's a 1v1 Tournament?
1v1 Tournament Guide
A group of fighters is divided into pairs of opponents, and they all fight their opponent. The winners of those fights proceed to the next round, where they're divided into pairs, and they each fight their new opponent.
1v1 Tournament Guide
The number of surviving fighters is halved each time, until eventually only one person is left standing. They're the winner of the Tournament.
(Shows other options)
Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
Player
Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
1v1 Tournament Guide
Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
1v1 Tournament Guide
In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Tournament, and send the invitations.
1v1 Tournament Guide
But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Tournament, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Tournament, and decide for yourself who'll fight in it.
1v1 Tournament Guide
Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
(Shows other options)
How do I get invited into a Tournament?
Player
How do I get invited into a Tournament?
1v1 Tournament Guide
You'll need to sign up to a recruitment group...
This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.
There, you can click Find to seek the official group for ranked Tournaments. Alternatively, you could look for another player's group, for an unranked Tournament.
Once you've found a suitable group for you, click Sign up to sign up to it, and you'll be considered for an invitation to a Tournament, whenever one begins.
1v1 Tournament Guide
You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a Tournament to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
(Shows other options)
I want to organise my own Tournament.
Player
I want to organise my own Tournament.
1v1 Tournament Guide
Just use my Recruitment Board here to form your own recruitment group. Once you've got one, wait for other fighters to join it.
This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Once you've formed a recruitment group, you'll be able to control it there, via the PvP Arena options.
When you're ready to start, click Start to summon your awaiting fighters. You'll need to be on a PvP Arena world  to start your Tournament.
What's a 1v1 Tournament?
(Same as above)
Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
(Same as above)
How do I get invited into a Tournament?
(Same as above)

Abigaila
What can I help you with, dear?
Who are you and what are you doing?
Player
Who are you and what are you doing?
Abigaila
I'm Abigaila, from Morytania. It's a terrible place, run by the vampyres. They visit the towns and collect everyone's blood for food!
Abigaila
I tried for years to escape, with my son, Suro, to make a better life for ourselves in Misthalin. I scraped together enough money to bribe a boatman to get us out.
Abigaila
The journey was tough. Some men in pink hoods attacked our boat, shouting at us to go back where we belonged, and to keep out of their country. In the struggle, the boat overturned.
Abigaila
It was dark, and I couldn't find Suro in the water. I swam as deep as I could, until my lungs screamed, but I couldn't find him. He wasn't good at swimming.
Abigaila
Eventually I got myself to the shore. The sun was rising, and I found Suro there. On the shore, where the water had dumped his... body.
Abigaila
*sob*
Abigaila
I've done alright in Misthalin, I guess. I know a bit of magic, and the local gentry pay me well for my scrying skills. I'm good at turning a profit on Grand Exchange trades too.
Abigaila
Anyway, I'm able to rent a room in Lumbridge, and to buy food. I'm not being a burden on anyone, and there are no vampyres coming for my blood.
Abigaila
I am free!
Abigaila
But I haven't forgotten my people in the east. There's one vampyre there who runs a place she calls the Theatre of Blood, challenging humans to face monsters in her arena.
Abigaila
My husband went there, trying to win freedom from the blood-gatherers by surviving her arena, but he never returned. No-one does.
Abigaila
So now I pass my spare time scrying on the Theatre of Blood, watching other adventurers there. You can have a look, if you like.

Killer

Player

Player

Abigale

Abigale

Player
What do you mean?
Abigale
Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
Player
I don't understand?
Abigale

Abigale

Abigale

Abigale

Abigale
But not this time!
Abigale
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
Player
Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
Abigale
Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
Player
What!? How!? There was another killer!?
Abigale

Killer
Of course, my love.

Player

Player

Hewey
Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
Player
But your friends?
Player

Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.

OUR starring role.

Abigale
Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
Hewey
No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
Abigale
Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
Hewey
Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
Abigale
We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
Hewey
You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.
Hewey
No...my love...
Hewey dies.
Abigale
No....no...what have I done!?
Abigale
It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
Player
This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
(End of dialogue)
The player stabs Abigale.
Player
Well thank Saradomin that's over! I should get out of here.
(End of dialogue)
Abigale
You'll never escape me!
In the background, Mandy gets up.
Abigale
You dare try and ruin my moment!
Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.
Abigale
Hewey is dead because of you!
Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.
Abigale
Now it is time for you to join him!
Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
Mandy
You're not killing anyone else!
Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.
Abigale
No....this can't be it....
Abigale dies.
Player
Wow, that was close!
Player
Mandy, how are you alive!? I watched you get stabbed through the heart!
Mandy
I did get stabbed, but I was born with a rare condition called Dextrocardia.
Player
Dextrowhat?
Mandy
Dextrocardia. It means that my heart is on the right side of my chest, not the left like most people.
Player
So when the killer thought they stabbed you in the heart, they actually missed?
Mandy
Well, missed the heart yes.
Mandy
I did still get stabbed though, and am actually feeling pretty woozy...
Player
Oh, yes, right! You should go sort yourself out!
Mandy
I will wait outside the house after seeing to this stab wound. You should come talk to me there.
(End of dialogue)

Player
Hello. Who are you?
Account Guide
I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.
Player
What's an account?
Account Guide
Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!
Account Guide
There?s various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let?s take a look at it now.
Account Guide
As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.
Account Guide
First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
Player
What's a world?
Account Guide
A world is what you play the game on. Each world can hold up to 2000 players and they are split into two main types, free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the world switcher in the logout menu.
If the player is on a free world
Account Guide
You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members? world and enjoy all of the benefits, you?ll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
If the player is on a members world
Account Guide
You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!
Account Guide
Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!
Player
But why would I use a Bond instead of just buying membership normally?
Account Guide
Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!
Player
So if I used my gold to buy a Bond from another player, I could get membership without spending any real money?
Account Guide
Exactly!
Account Guide
Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you?ll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
Account Guide
The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.
Account Guide
Finally, the bottom of the menu has some links which you might find useful. Make sure you check them out at some point.
Player
Awesome. Is there anything else I should know about accounts?
Account Guide
Only this. Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. You have many tools at your disposal to help out with this such as bank pins and authenticators.
Account Guide
You?ll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the useful links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
Account Guide
Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
(End of dialogue)

Player
Hello there.
Account security tutor
Hey there adventurer. I am Gordon, the Account security tutor. I can help you with anything account security related, would you like to know anything?
How can I keep my account secure?
Player
How can I keep my account secure?
Account security tutor
There are many ways you can strengthen your account security, which would you like to hear more about?
Tell me about passwords.
Player
Tell me about passwords.
Account security tutor
Your password is the first line of defence in keeping your account secure.
Account security tutor
When choosing a password, make sure to keep it unique. You can do this by using a mix of letters and numbers. You could even use numbers in the middle of your password.
Account security tutor
For extra security, you should make sure you use a different password for your account and email.
Account security tutor
You should keep your password safe and tell no one. Not even your friends or family.
Account security tutor
Is there anything else you would like to know?
(Shows other options)
Tell me about securing my email.
Player
Tell me about securing my email.
Account security tutor
Make sure you use a separate password for your email account. This will help boost your security and make it less likely for hijackers to steal your account.
Account security tutor
You should also enable two-step authentication on your email account, if your email supports it.
Account security tutor
This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
Account security tutor
The type of authenticator changes based on provider, but when active, hijackers will find it hard to access your account. Also, if you get any backup codes, keep them safe.
Account security tutor

Tell me about the authenticator.
Account security tutor
The RuneScape authenticator will provide your account with another layer of security against hijackers who might want to steal your account.
Account security tutor

Account security tutor

Account security tutor

If the player does not have a Bank PIN set up
Player
It seems I don't have one setup. How do I got[sic] about setting up a bank pin?
Account security tutor
To setup a bank pin you will need to visit any bank where you can find a banker. You should then speak to the banker and ask them about setting up a bank pin.
Account security tutor
After the bank pin has been set, you will need to wait a few days for the pin to take effect.

Account security tutor

Account security tutor
Be aware, the deeper into the stronghold you go, the tougher the monster will be. So make sure you bring your best equipment and some food.
Account security tutor
If you do manage to make it to the end of each floor, you will be able to loot the chest for some loot. But only once per floor.
Account security tutor

How can I keep my account secure?
Account security tutor

Tell me about passwords.
Player
Tell me about passwords.
Account security tutor
Your password is the first line of defence in keeping your account secure.
Account security tutor
When choosing a password, make sure to keep it unique. You can do this by using a mix of letters and numbers. You could even use numbers in the middle of your password.
Account security tutor
For extra security, you should make sure you use a different password for your account and email.
Account security tutor
You should keep your password safe and tell no one. Not even your friends or family.
Account security tutor
Is there anything else you would like to know?
(Shows other options)
Tell me about securing my email.
Player
Tell me about securing my email.
Account security tutor
Make sure you use a separate password for your email account. This will help boost your security and make it less likely for hijackers to steal your account.
Account security tutor
You should also enable two-step authentication on your email account, if your email supports it.
Account security tutor
This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
Account security tutor
The type of authenticator changes based on provider, but when active, hijackers will find it hard to access your account. Also, if you get any backup codes, keep them safe.

Adventurer Jon
Hello [player name], what can I do for you?
What are Adventure Paths?
Player
What are Adventure Paths?
Adventurer Jon
A long time ago, I was a newbie just like you who didn't know what to do and I would be more than happy to pass on my experience.
Adventurer Jon
I've created some Adventure Paths which I recommend you to start off with. An Adventure Path is a list of tasks which you can complete in any order.
Adventurer Jon
To help you get started on your Adventure Path, I'll also give you a starter kit with some useful items.
Adventurer Jon
Once you've completed an Adventure Path task, come back to me and I'll give you a reward.
(End of dialogue)
Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?

(Shows previous options)

How do I manage the kingdom?
Player
How do I manage the kingdom?
Advisor Ghrim
Your loyal subjects work hard to collect resources for you. Every day they bring what they have collected to the castle. The resources which they collect are coal from the rocks to the north, maple logs from the trees
Advisor Ghrim
to the east, herbs from the garden just outside the castle, and tuna and swordfish fished at the port to the south. Etceteria has also pledged you teak and mahogany logs from their trees to the north, and seeds
Advisor Ghrim
from their farm to the south. They are paid from the money in the coffers
Advisor Ghrim
coffers can store up to 7.5 million gp. Another thing which affects the amounts of resources collected is your approval rating. The more your subjects love you, the more they will be motivated to work hard. King Vargas
Advisor Ghrim
would often go and help out his subjects in their daily tasks, when he was still able to do so, and they loved him dearly for it. Finally, you can choose how much of their efforts your subjects devote to each resource
Advisor Ghrim
course, the harder they work at collecting one, the less time they have to spend collecting the others.

Aeonisig Raispher
Please only talk to the King if it's important. He has a heavy burden to bear with the running of his Kingdom.
Who are you?
Player
Who are you?
Aeonisig Raispher
Apologies! Allow me to introduce myself
my name is Aeonisig Raispher, special advisor to King Roald on spiritual matters.
Player
Special advisor on spiritual matters? What does that mean?
Aeonisig Raispher
It means that some decisions the King has to make might have unforeseen repercussions on the nation's spiritual sensibilities. My duty is to ensure that Saradominist ideals are not stomped underfoot.
(Shows initial options)
What do you do here?
Player
What do you do here?
Aeonisig Raispher
My main function is to ensure that King Roald is apprised of all options, especially those that favour the righteous followers of Saradomin.
Player
But surely the King should be able to make his own decisions on what's best for Misthalin?
Aeonisig Raispher
What an interesting perspective you have! Totally unworkable of course, but interesting nonetheless.
(Shows initial options)
Where did you come from?
Player
Where did you come from?
Aeonisig Raispher
I took my religious and combat training in several parts of the known world. I've also fought despicable beasts in the wilderness in Saradomin's name. Needless to say I have great experience in the ways of the world and am
Aeonisig Raispher
an invaluable aid to his lordship's decision-making process.
(Shows initial options)
How did you come to be an advisor to King Roald?
Player
How did you come to be an advisor to King Roald?
Aeonisig Raispher
The King of Misthalin, like any great leader, always requires the best advice and the best advisors. He very often summons occasional advisors to help him in certain situations, but it was felt by the Church of Saradomin
Aeonisig Raispher
that a full time advisor on religious matters was needed to ensure fair treatment of Saradomin's followers.
Player
How come he doesn't have an advisor for any other religious denominations?
Aeonisig Raispher
Because I simply won't stand for it, that's why! Now, enough of your impertinent questions. I have work to do!
(End of dialogue)
Okay, thanks.
Player
Okay, thanks.
(End of dialogue)

3.1 Talking to a cured villager
The Afflicted says one random phrase as described below.
Afflicted
~ This person doesn't make any sense at all. ~
(End of dialogue)

sfriess says knows'is says knows'is
Afflicted
pirsl nots
Afflicted
nots ughugh mee's
Afflicted
nots nots nots nots nots nots
Afflicted
says
The afflicted turns into a Mort'ton local
Mort'ton local
Oh... thank you, you used the serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
The local gives you [reward].
(Player receives one of the possible cure rewards.)
(End of dialogue)
Mort'ton local
Oh... thank you, you used the permanent serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
The local gives you [reward].
(Player receives one of the possible cure rewards.)
(End of dialogue)
Mort'ton Local
Oh I feel much better for that super serum,  I really hate it when I'm afflicted!
(End of dialogue)

How do I use the agility course?
Agility Boss
I'll throw you a stick, which you need to fetch as quickly as possible, from the area beyond the pipes.
Agility Boss
Be wary of the deathslide - you must hang by your teeth, and if your strength is not up to the job you will fall into a pit of spikes. Also, I would advise not carrying too much extra weight.
Agility Boss
Bring the stick back to the werewolf waiting at the end of the death slide to get your agility bonus.
Agility Boss
I will throw your stick as soon as you jump onto the first stone.

Player

Agmundi
What'd be the point? Besides, I don't make these clothes myself.
Who makes these clothes then?

Who makes these clothes then?

Ajjat
Greetings, fellow warrior. I am Ajjat, former black knight and now training officer here in the warrior guild.
Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
Player
Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
Ajjat
Skillcapes, also known as Capes of Accomplishment, are reserved for the elite of the elite. Only a person who has truly mastered a skill can buy one, and even then a skillcape can only be bought from one who is
Ajjat
recognised as the highest skilled in the land at any particular skill.
Ajjat
I have the privilege of being the person that controls access to the Skillcape of Attack, which Kamfreena will recognize and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
Ajjat
Is there anything else I can help you with?
(Shows initial options)
Black Knight? Why are you here?
Player
Black Knight? Why are you here?
Ajjat
Indeed I was, however their... methods... did not match with my ideals.. so I left. Harrallak, recognising my talent as a warrior, took me in and offered me a job here.
Player
Hmm... well if Harrallak trusts you, I guess I can.
(Shows initial options)
What's the Dummy Room all about?
Player
What's the Dummy Room all about?
Ajjat
Ahh yes, the dummies. Another ingenious invention of the noble Dwarf Gamfred. They're mechanical you see and pop up out of the floor. You have to hit them with the correct attack mode before they disappear again.
Player
So how do I tell which one is which?
Ajjat
There are two different ways. One indication is their colour, the other is the pose and weapons they are holding, for instance, the one holding daggers you will need to hit with a piercing attack.
Ajjat
In the room you will find a poster on the wall which can help you recognise each different dummy.
Player
That sounds ingenious!
Ajjat
Indeed, you may find that you need several weapons to be successful 100% of the time, but keep trying. The weapons shop upstairs may help you there.
(Shows initial options)

I wrote this poem when I went to the oasis to nibble at a tree, then discovered I'd left nothing for Elly to nibble. I was distraught.
Al the Camel
This Is Just To Say

Al the Camel
and which you were probably saving for lunch.
Al the Camel

I wonder if she's forgiven me for eating her snack.

Player
Hi.
Alchemy Guardian
Greetings young one. What wisdom do you seek?
Select an Option
What do I have to do in this room?
Player
What do I have to do in this room?
Alchemy Guardian
In this room you will see various cupboards. It is your task to search the cupboards to find items to turn into gold using your low or high alchemy spells. You can deposit the money in the receptacle at the end of the
Alchemy Guardian
hall in order to receive your Alchemist Pizazz Points. This money is used for the upkeep of the training arena as well as magic shops all around Gielinor. Keep an eye on the costs of each item as these will change
Alchemy Guardian
from time-to-time, as will the location of the items. Occasionally one of the items will be indicated as costing no runestones to convert to money.
(Shows initial options)
How will I be rewarded?
Player
How will I be rewarded?
Alchemy Guardian
You will get magic experience from casting the alchemist spells, as well as 1 Alchemist Pizazz Point for every 100 coins you deposit, and 10% of the coins you deposit will be given to you as you leave. Keep in mind that you
Alchemy Guardian
will not be able to take more than 1000 coins back out with you.
(Shows initial options)
Got any tips that may help me?
Player
Got any tips that may help me?
Alchemy Guardian
You must remember to keep an eye on the various costs of the items. If you watch the movements of the other players, you might be able to guess which are the best places to visit. You will get 1 Pizazz Point for
Alchemy Guardian
every 100 coins, so if you have 190 coins, why not get an extra 10?
Player
I see.
Alchemy Guardian
Oh, and a word of warning
should you decide to leave this room by a method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed, but the gold
Alchemy Guardian
coins and Pizazz points you earned will be granted.
(Shows initial options)
Thanks, bye!
Player
Thanks, bye!
Telekinetic Guardian
Use what you've learned, young one.
(End of dialogue)

Greetings adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.
Tell me about the Guild.
Player
Tell me about the Guild.
Alec Kincade
The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of this land to see if any facts may be hidden within them.
If the player has not finished Dragon Slayer II
Alec Kincade
We discover things here that others only dream of. The cost of entry is not insignificant though, only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
If the player has finished Dragon Slayer II
Alec Kincade
Here you will discover things that others only dream of. The cost of entry is not insignificant though, only the most worthy may share in our secrets.

Am I worthy?

(End of dialogue)

Alec Kincade
Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the Guild and you will reap the rewards within.
Alec Kincade
So do you feel up for the challenge?

Yes.

Good luck.

Ali Morrisane
Hello [player name]. How's the adventuring going?
Player
Hi Ali. Not bad. How are you?
Ali Morrisane
Still selling.
I would like to have a look at your selection of blackjacks.
Ali Morrisane
Hang on a second while I get my stock of blackjacks out.
(Ali's Discount Wares. (Blackjacks) interface opens.)
I would like to have a look at your selection of clothes.
Ali Morrisane
Hang on a second while I get the garments.
(Ali's Discount Wares. (Clothing) interface opens.)
I would like to have a look at your selection of runes.
Ali Morrisane
Hang on a second.
Ali Morrisane
Well at the moment I don't exactly have a selection of runes.
Player
You don't?
Ali Morrisane
Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.
Player
You have managed to get them off?
Ali Morrisane
Not exactly.
Player
What do you mean by 'not exactly'?
Ali Morrisane
What I mean by 'not exactly' is 'no, I haven't managed to get the lock off'.
Player
Oh.
Ali Morrisane
I was kind of hoping that you would have a look at them. There are two distinctive types of caskets one with a simple locking mechanism and another, which ummm... looks a little tricky to say the least.
Try opening a small casket of runes
Player
I think I'll have a go at opening a small casket of runes.

You fail to open the chest.
(End of dialogue)

Player
Hello there!
Ali the Farmer
Oh, er, hello. What do you want?
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
Player
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
Ali the Farmer
There's not much farming land around here. Only that little patch outside.
Player
Can you give me any advice on farming here in the desert?
Ali the Farmer
Like I said, I only know about cactuses...
Player
Just tell me about cactuses, then.
Ali the Farmer
First you have to weed the patch using a rake.
Player
Can you give me any other advice?
Ali the Farmer
Not really. I've not done much farming recently.
Player
Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?
Ali the Farmer
Sorry. They haven't been delivered yet.
So, what do you do here?
Player
So, what do you do here?
Ali the Farmer
I'm going to set up a shop selling farming implements. That patch out there may be small, but it's all we've got.
Player
Can you give me any advice on farming here in the desert?
Ali the Farmer
Like I said, I only know about cactuses...
Player
Just tell me about cactuses, then.
Ali the Farmer
First you have to weed the patch using a rake.
Player
Can you give me any other advice?
Ali the Farmer
Not really. I've not done much farming recently.
Player
Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?
Ali the Farmer
Sorry. They haven't been delivered yet.
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Player
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Ali the Farmer
Yes, he bought these tents and had them put up for us. He says he'll also get our goods in so we can start selling them soon.
Ali the Farmer
I only know how to farm cactuses, so this spot is perfect.
Player
Maybe I should talk to him...
Ali the Farmer
Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Player
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Ali the Farmer
Now why would you think that?
Player
One of the shopkeepers told they were threatened by a man with a rake...
Ali the Farmer
Those people just don't want us to succeed. Don't listen to them!
(End of dialogue)

Player
Hello there!
Ali the Guard
I'm working. What do you have to say that's so urgent?
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
Player
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
Ali the Guard
There's a lot of space here. More open space than back home.
Player
So where is back home?
Ali the Guard
Pollnivneach. It's a town to the south of the Shantay Pass.
So, what do you do here?
Player
So, what do you do here?
Ali the Guard
I'm on guard duty. Making sure nobody tries to steal anything from the house and tents in the middle of town.
Player
Why are you only guarding those buildings?
Ali the Guard
That's all I've been hired to guard.
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Player
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Ali the Guard
Yeah, he hired me. He owns this house and these two tents, too.
Player
Is the work good?
Ali the Guard
It pays better than back home.
Player
Why, what did you do back home?
Ali the Guard
Never you mind.
Ali the Guard
But Ali Morrisane pays us well, at least.
Player
Maybe I should talk to him...
Ali the Guard
Why not? He always likes to meet potential business partners.
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Player
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Ali the Guard
So? They talk too much.
Player
You're not going to deny it?
Ali the Guard
Why bother? None of them can fight back, after all.
(End of dialogue)

Player
Good day old hag.
Ali the Hag
Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!
Player
Does it happen to be... Ali?
Ali the Hag
Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!
Player
So can I call you Al?
Ali the Hag
Only if I can call you Betty!
Ali the Hag
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
Player
Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.
Ali the Hag
I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
Player
Sorry! I won't let it happen again.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Good day, Hag.
Alisha the Hag
Good day to you too, Blockhead.
Alisha the Hag
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
Player
Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.
Alisha the Hag
I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
Player
Sorry! I won't let it happen again.
(End of dialogue)

2.1.1 Answering the clue
2.1.1 Answering the clue
Player
Hello.
Ali the Kebab seller
Hello. What can I do for you?
Player
 I don't know, what can you do for me?
Ali the Kebab seller
Well, that depends.
Player
Depends on what?
Ali the Kebab seller
It depends on whether you like kebabs or not.
Player
Why is that?
Ali the Kebab seller
Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry, I mainly help people in need of a kebab.
Player
Well then, what kind of kebabs do you, er, construct?
Ali the Kebab seller
I offer two different types of kebabs
the standard run- of-the-mill kebab seen throughout Gielinor and enjoyed by many an intoxicated dwarf, and my speciality, the extra-hot kebab. So which shall it be?
Select an Option
I want a standard kebab, please.
Player
 I want a standard kebab, please.
Ali the Kebab seller
That will be three gold coins.
If the player has 3 coins
Ali the Kebab seller
Here you go.
Player
Thanks.
Ali the Kebab seller
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Select an Option
Yes, actually.
(Shows initial options)
No thanks, I'm good.
No thanks, I'm good.
Ali the Kebab seller
Come back soon, I could do with a few more customers.
(End of dialogue)
If the player does not have enough coins
Player
I seem to be short on coins. Sorry.
Ali the Kebab seller
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Select an Option
(Shows initial options)

(Same as above)
Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
Player
Could I have one of those crazy hot kebabs of yours?
Ali the Kebab seller

Player
Sure, sure.

Ali the Leaflet Dropper
I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.
Who is Ali Morrisane?
Player
Who is Ali Morrisane?
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Ali Morrisane is the greatest merchant in the east!
Player
Were you paid to say that?
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Of course I was! You can find him on the north edge of town.
(End of dialogue)
What are the flyers for?
Player
What are the flyers for?
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
I think they're just sour because he's better at making money than them.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
The flyer advertises the different shops you can find in Al Kharid.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
It also entitles you to money off your next purchase in any of the shops listed on it. It's Ali's way of getting on the good side of the traders.
Player
Which shops?
If the player does not have an Al kharid flyer
(Player receives Al kharid flyer.)
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Here! Take one and let me get back to work.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if my boss would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?
(End of dialogue)
If the player already has an Al kharid flyer
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? Look at the flyer you already have!
(End of dialogue)
If the player has a full inventory
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
I'd give you a flyer but it looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.
(End of dialogue)
What is there to do round here, boy?
Player
What is there to do round here, boy?
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
I'm very busy, so listen carefully! I shall say this only once.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Emir's Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Watch out for scorpions though, they'll take a pop at you if you go too near them. To avoid them just follow the western fence as you travel south.
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.
Player
Thanks for the help!
(End of dialogue)
Using a leaflet on Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Player
I don't want this! It's out of date!
Ali the Leaflet Dropper
Then why would I want it? Keep moving, I have to hand all these flyers out before I get paid.
(End of dialogue)

Tell me about houses!
Player
Tell me about houses!
Alwyn
It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
Alwyn

Player

Alwyn

Alwyn

Player
Tell me about houses!
Alwyn
It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
Alwyn
They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
Player
Ah, so that's how everyone can have a house without them cluttering up the world!
Alwyn
Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
Alwyn
There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
Alwyn
You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
Alwyn
As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
Alwyn
If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
Alwyn
The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
(End of dialogue)
Player
Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
Alwyn
Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
I'm not paying that!
Player
I'm not paying that!
Alwyn
Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
(End of dialogue)
Certainly, that sounds fair.
Player
Certainly, that sounds fair.
If the player does not have at least 99,000 coins
Player
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
Alwyn
Well, come back and see me when you do.
(End of dialogue)

Hello!
Alyssa
Hello, if you've something important to tell me, be out with it! I'm a busy woman.

Just making small talk.
Alyssa
How very nice of you. However, I'm sure there are less busy people who'd love to chat.
Player
Oh, okay.
Alyssa
Chin up love and go adventure, that's what you lot do right?
Player
I suppose we do, bye!
(End of dialogue)
Who are you?
Player
Who are you?
Alyssa
I'm Alyssa the housekeeper and this castle needs constant attention! I've enough trouble with the guards messing up my carpets without you adding to the problem.
Player
Hmm, yeah sorry about that. Speaking of carpets, ever thought how strange that there are carpets beneath the stairs?
Alyssa
It's cut to fit! If I had a gold piece for everytime I was asked that question!
Player
Sure... Cut to fit... Not an oversight at all.
Alyssa

Player
Hello there.
Amrod
Adventurer.
Player
What do you do?
Amrod
I'm a trader of sorts, but only to those who don't ask too many questions.
Player
Interesting, what do you offer?
Amrod
I can give you crystal shards in return for crystal seeds.
Yes.
Chatbox trade interface opens for crystal seed exchanging.
No.
Player
I'll pass, maybe another time.
(End of dialogue)
Chatbox trade interface opens for crystal seed exchanging.
Player
I'll pass, maybe another time.
(End of dialogue)

Amy
Hey I'm Amy, how may I help you?
Player
What do you do here?
Amy
I'm the founder of Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first Construction company!
Amy
We've currently got branches in Falador, Varrock, Hosidius and Ardougne.
Player
So people contact you for help with their homes?
Amy
Yep! They'll get in contact if they want assistance, whether it's fixing parts of their house or requesting nicer furniture, and then we will go and help them out.
Player
That sounds quite enjoyable and satisfying to do, are you hiring at all?
Amy
If you have the supplies, I can tell you where one of our clients is that needs some work doing.
Amy
I'll keep track of the work you do as well and give you some points for our company reward shop.
Amy
Also there are assistants in Varrock, Ardougne, and Hosidius that can give you work, if Falador is inconvienent for you.
Amy
The clients that I would offer you to go help could be in any of those cities, it might be a bit of a journey to get there!
I'd like a construction contract.
Player
I'd like a construction contract.
Amy
What kind of contract would you like?
Beginner Contract
Player
Could I have a beginner contract please?
Amy
Please could you go see [client] [area] [city], [location description] for us? You can get another job once you have furnished [his/her] home.
Go see [client] [area] [city], [location description]

1 Standard dialogue
1.1 Without ghostspeak amulet
1.2 Aviansie ghost (with ghostspeak amulet)
1.3 Ork ghost (with ghostspeak amulet)
1.1 Without ghostspeak amulet
1.2 Aviansie ghost (with ghostspeak amulet)
1.3 Ork ghost (with ghostspeak amulet)
Ancient Ghost
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
You cannot understand the ghost.
(End of dialogue)
Ancient Ghost
You! Which god do you serve?
Player
Err... What?
Ancient Ghost
The war! What side do you fight on?
Player
War? There's no war?
Ancient Ghost
No war? But I was fighting earlier today.
Player
I hate to say it, but I don't think that's true. You're dead.
Ancient Ghost
Dead? That can't be! I am a loyal warrior of...
Player
Of?
Ancient Ghost
I... I don't know. I can't remember.
Ancient Ghost
We came here to fight. But I don't know who for. It's like it was moments ago, but also a lifetime in the past.
Player
Do you know who you were fighting against?
Ancient Ghost
No. We were here to claim something. To protect it. But everything else is unclear.
Ancient Ghost
I'm sorry, this is all so confusing. I need some time to try and understand.
Player
Well I hope it all works out for you. Good luck.
(End of dialogue)
Ancient Ghost
Die puny chicken!
Player
What? I'm not a chicken.
Ancient Ghost
You wear cunning disguise. I see though. You flappy chicken! You die in name of Big High War God.
Player
There's no Big High War God here.
Ancient Ghost
Lies! Big High War God use the shiny to kill the chickens! Now we clear up the rest!
Player
Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think this 'shiny' might have killed you as well.
Ancient Ghost
Chicken play mind games, but I no fool. You die now!
Player
You know there's normally not this much talking before dying.
Ancient Ghost
Yes! No talking! Only die!
Player
...
Player
I'm waiting.
Ancient Ghost
Arghhh!
Player
I think I'll leave you to it.
(End of dialogue)

3.1 Port Phasmatys
3.2 Slepe
Andras
Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe? I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
Yes please.
Player
Yes please.
If the player does not have at least 10,000 coins
Andras
Doesn't look like you have enough money. I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
(End of dialogue)
If the player has at least 10,000 coins
Player gives Andras 10,000 coins.
Andras transports the player to Slepe.
(End of dialogue)
Where's Slepe?
Player
Where's Slepe?
Andras
It's a small village to the south of here. You can walk but the boat is safer and faster.
Player
Is there anything to do there?
Andras
I guess that depends what interests you. The place is pretty quiet, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
Andras
There's also Ver Sinhaza to the south, home to the Theatre of Blood. It's definitely worth having a look around, even if you don't intend to participate yourself.
Andras
So, do you want to go to Slepe?
Yes please.
(Same as above)
No thank you.
(Same as below)

Yes please.

(Continues below)
Andros Mai
Vet'ion was a devout follower of the heretical god Zamorak. It is the will of my order and my duty as a follower of the true god Saradomin to end his tyranny.
Andros Mai
After many years in my order's libraries, I stumbled upon an old tome which mentioned Vet'ion's final resting place, which I believe to be his source of power.
Andros Mai
His very existence is an insult to my lord Saradomin and I will not suffer it to exist any longer.
Player
Then why are you waiting here? Seems to me that you don't want to face Vet'ion.
Andros Mai
I have no fear of Vet'ion!
Andros Mai

This conversation is over! Leave me before I lose my temper.

Apmeken
You did it! I wasn't sure I'd make it out of that one, but I'm glad you proved me wrong. Come, let's get out of here.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hi there. How are you doing?
Apmeken
Oh, you know, just getting over years of being controlled by a deranged family member. All part of the fun in a family like ours, I guess.
Player
You seem quite jolly about it all.
Apmeken
Well as I always say, 'the real winner is the one smiling.' What Amascut has done is horrific, but it's not too late to stop her. I won't let her get me down, not while there's still hope.
Apmeken
Anyway, I'm annoyingly a bit too weak to help you much down here. However, I reckon if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to the lower level for you.
(End of dialogue)
Apmeken
We've been able to open the way for you! I wish we could help you down there, but we're still too weak. Don't worry though, I know you can do it!
(End of dialogue)
Apmeken
Here he is!
Het
My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
Player
Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
Crondis
Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
Het
Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
Apmeken
Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
Het
Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
Crondis
If you do, now is the time to ask them.

What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?

Player
A cold sun god?
Apmeken
Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
Apmeken
My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
(Shows other options)
Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?

Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?

Player

Apmeken
Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!

I have a question for Het.
Player
I have a question for Het.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
Player
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
Het
I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
Player
You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
Het
Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
Player
I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
Het
Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
Player
So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
Het
Exactly!
(Shows other options)
Do you have more followers than the others?
Het
An interesting question. Why do you ask?
Player
Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
Het
Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
Apmeken
Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
Het
Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
Het
Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
(Shows other options)
Actually, I've changed my mind.
Player
Actually, I've changed my mind.
Het
Very well.
(Shows initial options)
I'll be back soon.
Player
I'll be back soon.
Het
We'll wait for you to return.
(End of dialogue)

Are you actually gods?
Player
Are you actually gods?
Het
If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
Crondis
Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
Player
How so?
Apmeken
Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
Crondis

Player
So what are you really?
Het
You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
Player
What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
Apmeken
Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
Crondis
But again, they are not true gods.
Het
Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
(Shows other options)

Player
Actually, I've changed my mind.
Apmeken
Fair enough.
(Shows initial options)

Player
I'll be back soon.
Apmeken
We'll be here when you're ready.
(End of dialogue)
So what happens now?
Player
So what happens now?
Crondis

Apmeken
We're going to get started right away!
Het
But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
Crondis
For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
Apmeken
It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
The avatars depart.

Talk about Romeo & Juliet.
If the player hasn't talked to the Apothecary before
Player
Apothecary, Father Lawrence sent me. I need a Cadava potion to help Romeo and Juliet.
Apothecary
Cadava potion. It's pretty nasty. And hard to make.
Apothecary
Wing of rat, tail of frog. Ear of snake and horn of dog.
Apothecary
I have all that, but I need some Cadava berries.
Apothecary
You will have to find them while I get the rest ready. Bring them here when you have them. But be careful. They are nasty.
If the player has cadava berries in their inventory
Player
Conveniently, I have some here.
The player gives the Apothecary the cadava berries.
You hand over the berries, which the Apothecary shakes up in a vial of strange liquid.
Apothecary
Phew! Here is what you need.
(Player receives a cadava potion.)
The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
(End of dialogue)
If the player does not have cadava berries in their inventory
What do these berries look like?
Player
What do these berries look like?
Apothecary
They're a nice bright pink colour, with green leaves, stalks are a pale brown colour...you can't miss them. They look pretty tasty, but I wouldn't advise eating them.
(Shows previous options)
Where can I get these berries?
Player
Where can I get these berries?
Apothecary
I think I saw some recently in the local vicinity. Oh yes, that's right! There was a little bit of commotion when some kids visited the south eastern Varrock mining pit. The trip was disrupted because some kids
Apothecary
had found some cadavaberry bushes and they started picking them. They wrapped that trip up pretty quickly!
(Shows previous options)
How are these berries dangerous?
Player
How are these berries dangerous?
Apothecary
Hmm, they're generally okay, but if handled improperly they can be a bit nasty. And I certainly wouldn't advise drinking the potion!
(Shows previous options)
Ok, thanks.
Player
Ok, thanks.
(End of dialogue)
If the player has talked to the Apothecary about the cadava potion
If the player doesn't have either cadava berries or the cadava potion in their inventory
Apothecary
Keep searching for those Cadavaberries[sic]. They're needed for the potion.
(End of dialogue)
If the player has cadava berries in their inventory
Apothecary
Well done. You have the berries.

Apothecary
Phew! Here is what you need.
(Player receives a cadava potion.)
The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
(End of dialogue)

Hello!
Apprentice (medium)
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!

Player
Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
Apprentice (medium)
I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
Player
But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
Apprentice (medium)
Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
Player
And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
Apprentice (medium)

Player
It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
(Shows initial options)
Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?

Player
I was wondering if you could repair my pouches.
Apprentice Cordelia
I need 25 abyssal pearls to unlock the contact with the mage who knows how to repair a pouch. After the contact has been unlocked, it will cost you 1 abyssal pearl each time to repair the pouches.
If the player does not have enough abyssal pearls in their inventory
Player
I don't have enough abyssal pearls for that, I'm afraid.
(End of dialogue)
If the player has enough abyssal pearls in their inventory

Yes

Contact Weird Gloop
Mobile view
Apprentice Felix
Hey, [player name]. Got any abyssal pearls you want to trade?
Select an Option
Let's see what you have.
Player
Let's see what you have.
Apprentice Felix
I have my general store, but I also have a small collection of lanterns available, if that interests you?
Select an Option
Can I see your general items?
(Temple Supplies interface opens.)
Lanterns, you say?
Player
Lanterns, you say?
Apprentice Felix
Yes, powerful artefacts of The Abyss. We have accumulated a small collection of them from all of the fighting.
Player
Do the wizards not use them in the fight against the abyss?
Apprentice Felix
Absolutely not. We know how powerful they are, yet their magic is too unknown to us to risk using.
Player
Could I have one to aid in the fight?
Apprentice Felix
I'm afraid I can't just give you one. We're under strict instructions to only provide lanterns to people who prove themselves as committed to the cause.
Player
How committed does one have to be?
Apprentice Felix
If you've fought the abyss enough to amass 1,500 abyssal pearls, that would be enough.
If the player does not have enough abyssal pearls in their inventory
Player
Ah, I don't have enough on me right now.
Apprentice Felix
That's alright. Feel free to come back when you have more pearls on you.
(End of dialogue)
If the player has at least 1,500 abyssal pearls in their inventory
Apprentice Felix
As long as you are aware of how powerful they are, and that I can trust you won't lost it.
Select an Option
I understand how powerful these are, I'd like to buy one.
(Transcript missing. edit)
I'm not sure I'm ready to buy one yet.
(End of dialogue)
What's that rift guardian doing over there?
Player
What's that rift guardian doing over there?
Apprentice Felix
They're great, aren't they? I don't know their name, if they even have one, so I just call them Rifty.
Apprentice Felix
That rift they have is a folded-space storage rift, just like the ones Traiborn uses! Small on the outside, but big on the inside!
Player
But what's the rift for?
Apprentice Felix
The guardians use it to store things. If you help hold back the Abyss, they'll let you take things from the rift in return.
Apprentice Felix
Anyway, did you want to trade?
(Shows other options)
Why are you selling things here?
Player
Why are you selling things here?
Apprentice Felix
Sedridor told us to make sure there was plenty of incentive for people to help us. He also wants us to gather abyssal pearls for research purposes. I thought this would be a good way of doing both!
Player
So you sell things in exchange for abyssal pearls?
Apprentice Felix
Exactly! I've got some interesting things from the Wizards' Tower, along with some cool stuff the Guardians of the Rift gave us. Want to take a look?
(Shows other options)
Could you tell me more about this place.[sic]
Player
Could you tell me more about this place.
Apprentice Felix
Well, I only really know what the Great Guardian told us. This is the Temple of the Eye, or at least, what's left of it. It was built long ago to house the Eye, a powerful Saradominist artefact.
Apprentice Felix
Apparently, servants of some 'Fallen Empire' desired this artefact. However, in their attempt to steal it, they accidently opened a rift into a deadly area of the Abyss called the Scar.
Apprentice Felix
Were it not for the Justiciar of the Lion, the rift would have endangered all of Gielinor. She used the Eye to close it and then created the Guardians of the Rift to protect this temple.
Apprentice Felix
Of course, the rift is open again now, but with our help, the Guardians of the Rift are keeping it under control.
Apprentice Felix
Anyway, did you want to trade?
(Shows other options)
(If the player is holding a dye
) I found this dye in the rewards rift...
Player
I found this dye in the rewards rift...
Apprentice Felix
And you want me to change it to a different one?
Select an Option
Yes, but how did you know?
Player
Well, yes, but how did you know?
Apprentice Felix
You'd be surprised at how often this happens. Lots of adventurers have been pulling bottles of dye out of that rift, only to wish they'd got a different one. I've ended up with plenty of spares.
Apprentice Felix
So on that note, would you like me to swap your dye for you?
Select an Option
(If the player has abyssal red dye
) I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal green dye.
Player
I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal green dye.
Felix exchanges your abyssal red dye for some abyssal green dye.
Player
Thanks, Felix.
Apprentice Felix
Any time, [player name].
(End of dialogue)

Player
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
Archmage Sedridor
Of course. The first Wizards' Tower was built at the same time the Order of Wizards was founded. It was at the dawn of the Fifth Age, when the secrets of runecrafting were rediscovered.
Archmage Sedridor
For years, the tower was a hub of magical research. Wizards of all races and religions were welcomed into our order.
Archmage Sedridor
Alas, that openness is what ultimately led to disaster. The wizards who served Zamorak, the evil god of chaos, tried to claim our magical discoveries in his name.
Archmage Sedridor
They failed, but in retaliation, they burnt the entire tower to the ground. Years of work was destroyed.
Archmage Sedridor
The tower was soon rebuilt of course, but even now we are still trying to regain knowledge that was lost.
Archmage Sedridor
That's why I spend my time down here, in fact. This basement is all that is left of the old tower, and I believe there are still some secrets to discover here.
Archmage Sedridor
Of course, one secret I am no longer looking for is the teleportation incantation to the Rune Essence Mine. We have you to thank for that.

2.1 Without an Amulet of ghostspeak or Morytania legs 2 or higher equipped

Player
Who are you?
Archpriest of the Unicorn
Woo wooo?
(End of dialogue)
Player
Who are you?
Archpriest of the Unicorn
Me? I am the Archpriest who was responsible for the running of this place! I am impressed that you managed to reach my resting place on the lowest level.
Player
Well it wasn't easy for sure. You wouldn't believe how difficult it was to overcome some of those traps.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
The intention was that they should've been impossible to pass. I should know. After all, it was I who was responsible for overseeing the safeguarding of this place.
Player
Why did you need the safeguards? Surely they made it more difficult to do your work down here?
Archpriest of the Unicorn
I'm not sure if I should say... I wouldn't want to compromise the trust that the Justiciar of the Unicorn has in me. Afterall, we did what we did for the safety of Hallowvale.
Player
So... about that. Hallowvale no longer exists. The Hallowed Sepulchre is now beneath the vampyre capital of Darkmeyer within the lands of Morytania.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
I see... So we lost then? In that case, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you after all.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
One day the justiciar sent word to me that I should begin work on securing the Sepulchre. He feared an invasion from the followers of the Dark Lord.
Player
Do you mean Zamorak?
Archpriest of the Unicorn
Yes, I do. The justiciar said he was going to confront these forces but that I should stay to protect the secrets within this place. I wish I could have joined him on the battlefield. I carried out my duties though.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
I never told the others what was really happening. Day by day we worked our way down to the final floor.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
As we progressed further, we became more experienced at creating the traps. Each one was more deadly than the last.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
Eventually, when our work was done, I performed the last rites for each of my followers and sealed them within the coffins on the final floor.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
Finally, I did the same for myself. The knowledge of how to disarm the traps died with us.
Player
You buried yourselves alive? That's... horrible!
Archpriest of the Unicorn
No, I think at that point most of us were already dead. We died knowing that we sacrificed ourselves for the good of holy Saradomin and the justiciars who follow him.
Player
Well, at the very least you succeeded at keeping the vampyres out of the Sepulchre. From what I have seen, none of them have been able to enter.
Archpriest of the Unicorn
I am glad adventurer. Perhaps that information will allow my spirit to pass on peacefully soon.
(End of dialogue)
Archpriest of the Unicorn
Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
(End of dialogue)
Archpriest of the Unicorn
What are you doing in my coffin? Leave this holy place at once!
(End of dialogue)

Player
What is this place?
Arena Guard Beni
This is the Emir's Arena. Fighters come from far and wide to arrange fights against their friends and rivals. They can fight in 1v1 Tournaments or Duels.
The Arena is open only on PvP Arena worlds. Switch to one of those game worlds to play in the Arena.
Arena Guard Beni
Head over to the hospital north of the Arena, and speak to the Guides. They'll help you sign up to a fight. Now, can I help you with anything else?
(Shows other options)

Player
What do you do here?

Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
Player
Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
Arena Guard Beni
The Calamity Coven were three brigands, followers of an ancient and derelict religion. Through their foul arts, they turned this Arena into a hotbed of corruption.
Arena Guard Beni
Maoma was a captain of the Emir's guard, but she abused her authority to rig fights so that the Coven would get rich at the people's expense.
Arena Guard Beni
Saika was the brains behind their operation, forging the Arena's accounts so that the Coven could keep all the profits, starving the Emir's public works of all funding.
Arena Guard Beni
Koriff used her charms to act as a gracious hostess, whipping up the crowds' excitement so that they'd gamble more and more unwisely, enriching the Coven.
Arena Guard Beni
The Calamity Coven are long gone now

Why are all these souls here?
Player
Why are all these souls here?
Aretha

Aretha

Aretha

Aretha

Aristarchus
I'm sorry, but I'm currently doing some research. Could you talk to me later, please?
Player
Okay then.
(End of dialogue)
Aristarchus
Good day, [madam/sir]. Are you interested in the history of this area?
Select an Option
Tell me about yourself.
Player
Tell me about yourself.
Aristarchus

Select an Option

Tell me about Enakhra.
Player
Tell me about Enakhra.
Aristarchus
Enakhra? I have read only a little about her. She was one of the Mahjarrat who arrived in Gielinor many thousands of years ago.
Aristarchus
She supported Zamorak when he tried to gain power, and she apparently built a great temple in his honour somewhere in the desert.
Aristarchus
However, it is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods.
Aristarchus
That is the last anyone knows of what happened to her, and it took place several thousand years ago.
Select an Option
Tell me about yourself.
(Same as above)
Tell me about Akthanakos.
(Same as below)
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
Player
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
(End of dialogue)
Tell me about Akthanakos.
Player
Tell me about Akthanakos.
Aristarchus
An interesting choice of topic. Akthanakos is a Mahjarrat who was apparently worshipped as a god for a while in these parts. That was a long time ago, of course.
Aristarchus
Unlike many of his kin, he was against Zamorak's rise to power. Perhaps that's why he ended up out here. Zamorak has little sway in the desert.
Aristarchus
Whatever his reasons, he clearly took a liking to living here. He took on the head of a camel and even made an amulet that would allow him to understand their kind.
Aristarchus
Using it, he even trained some of the native camels to fight for him. Their name, 'Ugthanki', is derived from his.
Aristarchus
Since he disappeared, however, it is said that the Ugthanki became more violent and started attacking travellers.

Enakhra the Mahjarrat
Player

Aristarchus

(End of dialogue)
Akthanakos the Mahjarrat
Player
Tell me about Akthanakos the Mahjarrat.
Aristarchus
Like Enakhra, his rival, Akthanakos came to Gielinor with the other Mahjarrat. He took on the aspect of one of the local gods, and is usually drawn with a camel's head.
Aristarchus
He was against Zamorak's rise to power, but the last anyone knows of him was that he and Enakhra were thinking of forgetting their rivalry.
(End of dialogue)
Enakhra's temple
Player
Tell me about Enakhra's temple.
Aristarchus
Well, my sources say that Enakhra tried to gain favour with Zamorak by building him a temple somewhere in the desert.
Aristarchus
It is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods than a temple.
Aristarchus
After that, it seems that Enakhra retreated to that temple. If she hasn't died, she's been there ever since.
(End of dialogue)
The Camulet
Player
Tell me about the Camulet.
Aristarchus
I'm afraid I've only heard rumours of it, but here's what I know.
Aristarchus
When Akthanakos came to Gielinor and took on the aspect of a man with a camel's head, he made an amulet that would allow him to understand camels.
Aristarchus
Using it, he even trained some of the native camels to fight for him. Their name, 'Ugthanki', is derived from his.
Aristarchus
Since he disappeared, however, it is said that the Ugthanki became more violent and started attacking travellers.
(End of dialogue)
Why should I care about what happened thousands of years ago?
Player
Why should I care about what happened thousands of years ago?
Aristarchus
Because those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
Aristarchus
Knowing something about history can prevent you from making mistakes that people have made before, you see.
(End of dialogue)

Aristarchus
Unfortunately, the plague in Sophanem prevents me from returning to the library.
(End of dialogue)

Arno
Hello there.
What's in this cave?
Player
What's in this cave?
Arno
A unique farming patch. This cave is the only place we've succesfully[sic] been able to grow a Hespori.
Player
What's a Hespori?
Arno
A rare carnivorous plant originally from Morytania. When grown, the plant becomes conscious and highly aggressive. They are truly fascinating.
Player
Can I grow one?
Arno
Of course. Just plant some Hespori seeds in the cave below and it will grow like any other plant. A Hespori is pretty tough so you don't need to worry about it getting diseased.
Arno
Do be careful though. A fully grown Hespori can be quite troublesome to deal with.
Arno
Do you need anything else?
(Shows other options)
Do you have any of my items?
Player
Do you have any of my items?
If the player has no items in Arno's collection
Arno
I'm afraid not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
(End of dialogue)
If the player has items in Arno's collection
Arno
I do indeed. You really should be more careful.
(Arno's Item Retrieval Service interface opens.)
(If the player can currently find Hespori seeds when farming
) I don't want to find Hespori seeds when farming.
Player
I don't want to find Hespori seeds when farming.
Arno
Very well. You'll no longer find Hespori seeds when farming.
Arno
Do you need anything else?
(Shows other options)
(If the player cannot currently find Hespori seeds when farming
) I want to find Hespori seeds when farming.
Player
I want to find Hespori seeds when farming.
Arno
Very well. You'll now have a chance of finding Hespori seeds when farming.
Arno
Do you need anything else?
(Shows other options)
Goodbye.
Player
Goodbye.
(End of dialogue)

Hello.
Art Critic Jacques
Ahh many greetinks and welcomes to ze Museum!
Who are you?
Player
Who are you?
Art Critic Jacques

Player
Looks to me like you're the ONLY one.
Art Critic Jacques
Zis iz true, mon amie. 'owever, in ze future, I will 'ave my own entire floor of ze Museum with paintings galore!
Player
Uhh... Has that been approved or are you just dreaming?
Art Critic Jacques
Ah, I see [madame/monsieur] iz 'aving ze little bon mot, eh?
Player
Err...bone what?
Art Critic Jacques
Ze bon mot, ze laugh, ze fun of poking at me, eh? I shall 'ave my gallery, you vill see eventually, mon amie. Zen I shall be ze, 'ow you say, laughing last!
(End of dialogue)
What do you do here?
Player
What do you do here?
Art Critic Jacques

Umm...it's a painting.
Player
Umm...it's just a painting.
Art Critic Jacques
JUST a painting? 'ow could you say such a t'ing? When you learn 'ow to appreciate ze wonderful works of art, you may talk to me.
Yes, I see!
Player

Player

Art Critic Jacques

Art Critic Jacques

Yes please.
Player
Yes please.
Art Critic Jacques

Art Critic Jacques
Je tr?ne dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris
That was nice, what did it mean?

Wow!

Oui...so eet eez. So perfect it almost makes me weep wiz joy! The grandiloquent strokes of ze brush convey a kind of mystic quality...eet iz almost as if 'e were 'ere with us.
Art Critic Jacques
My father, 'e too waz ze critic of art...'e also saw ze poetry in ze painting. Zis reminds me of a verse 'e would read me - would you like to 'ear it?
Yes please.
Player
Yes please.
Art Critic Jacques
Ahh, good. Zis verse is from a poem by a most talented writer of ze poetry, Charles Baudelaire. My father would place me on 'is knee and read to me like zis...
Art Critic Jacques
Je tr?ne dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris
That was nice, what did it mean?
Player
That was nice, what did it mean?
Art Critic Jacques
Ahh yes, I forget, open ze ears and I shall tell [madame/monsieur].
Art Critic Jacques
Swan-white of heart, a sphinx no mortal knows, My throne is in the heaven's azure deep, I hate all movements that disturb my pose, I smile not ever, neither do I weep.
Wow!
Player
Wow.
Player
That's powerful stuff...and yes, I see what you mean about the painting inspiring you to remember that poem...
Art Critic Jacques
I am glad you enjoyed. Please, take ze time to appreciate ze Museum and ze wealth of information 'ere. Come visit me when I 'ave my own gallery!
(End of dialogue)
I still didn't like it.
Player
I still didn't like it.
Art Critic Jacques
Eet iz such a shame, but you must 'ave your own opinion, no? Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
(End of dialogue)
Beautiful.
Player
Beautiful.
Art Critic Jacques
Ahh yes, it eez. Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
(End of dialogue)
I didn't like it, but I still like the painting.
Player
I didn't like it, but I still like the painting.
Art Critic Jacques
Ahh well, eet iz not for everyone but I am glad you like ze painting.
(End of dialogue)
No thanks.
