Arthur the Clue Hunter
What can I do for you?
Ask about beginner clues.
Player
What are beginner clues?
Arthur's eyes light up.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Beginner clues are the lowest tier of clue scroll and as such only require a couple of steps to solve.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Beginner clues are gained through various activities. Those activities are as follows.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Slaying monsters for a chance at a clue being dropped. I hear goblins are sneaky, maybe they have some clue scrolls on them ripe for the taking.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Maybe someone left one in the cow field, who knows where you could obtain them.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Beginner clues have also been known to be left in geodes while mining, as well as sometimes in bottles that you may fish up from time to time and from nests which fall out of trees.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Although this is a much rarer occurrence.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Unlike more advanced clues, you should not expect to get very valuable items from completing a beginner clue.
(Shows previous options)
Ask about more advanced clues.
Player
What are more advanced clues?
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Advanced clues have tiers between easy and master.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
You can gain advanced clues the same way you would get a beginner clue. But to get higher tier scrolls you will need to defeat more powerful foes.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
The chance to get a higher tier clue from geodes, bottles and nests is lower the higher the tier. But if you chop down higher-level trees you will have a higher chance of receiving a nest which contains a clue. Same with fishing and mining.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
The only exception to this is master clue scrolls.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Master clues can only be obtained as a rare chance when opening your casket or by handing in one of every type of clue, apart from beginner, to Watson who resides in Hosidius.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
But with more advanced tiers of clue, come better loot.
(Shows previous options)
Ask about the types of clues.
Anagrams.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
You will see a couple of words that may or may not make sense together. You will have to rearrange the letter to make the name of the person you need to talk to.
(Shows previous options)
Challenge scrolls.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue has you work out a logical problem for the person you need to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
There are also challenges that will involve you gathering an item or crafting an item for a certain person.
(Shows previous options)
Cipher clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
A cipher is a string of letters that have been scrambled using the shift cipher method.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
An example of this would be ZCZL which, shifted forward by one, would be Adam.
(Shows previous options)
Coordinate clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue will have you use a sextant, chart and a watch to find out the place you will need to dig. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
After you find the place you need to dig, you may find a casket or another scroll.
(Shows previous options)
Cryptic clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue can be as simple as talk to the specified person or searching a crate in a specified location.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
But the higher the tier of clue, the more steps you will have to do beforehand. An example of this would be needing to find a key before opening a chest.
(Shows previous options)
Emote clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue will give you a location that you will need to visit, along with some items you will need.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
At this location you will need to perform an emote, as well as wear the items that you had to bring along.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Some clues may have you wear nothing at all.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
But please don't do that in public!
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
(Shows previous options)
Hot Cold clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Depending on the tier of clue, you will need to obtain a strange device from either Reldo, located in Varrock, or Jorral, located south of Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
You will then need to use this device to find the location you will need to dig.
(Shows previous options)
Puzzle clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
There are many different puzzles that you can come across while doing clues. These range from light boxes to puzzle boxes.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Puzzle boxes are puzzles that will have you complete a slider puzzle that, when complete, will look like an image in game.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Light boxes are a puzzle which contains a 5 by 5 grid of lights with some lights on and some lights off.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
The puzzle will have you click the buttons below to turn on or off some of the lights with the end goal being, having all the lights turned on.
(Shows previous options)
Map clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue will show you a map of an area.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
(Shows previous options)
Fairy ring clues.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
This type of clue will show you which fairy ring code you will need to use to get to the right place to dig.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
You will then need to use the numbers to figure our where you will need to dig after arriving to your destination.
(Shows previous options)
Toggle gaining vesseled clue scrolls.
If vesseled clue scrolls are currently toggled on
Player
Hey Arthur, can I stop receiving clues from vessels? They're clogging up my backpack!
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to stop receiving them?
Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
Player
Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Very well, you'll no longer find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Is there anything else I can help you with?
(Shows initial options)
Nevermind.
(Shows initial options)
If vesseled clue scrolls are currently toggled off
Player
Hey Arthur, can I start receiving clues from vessels?
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to start receiving them, again?
Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers
Player
Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Very well, you'll now find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
Is there anything else I can help you with?
(Shows initial options)
Nevermind.
(Shows initial options)
Goodbye.
Player
Goodbye.
Arthur the Clue Hunter
So long and happy clue hunting!
(End of dialogue)

Player
Hello again Artur.
Artur Hosidius
Hello [player name]. Thanks for your help in recovering the Accord.
Player
No problem.
Why is the Accord important?
Player
Why is the Accord important?
Artur Hosidius
The signing of the Accord marked the start of a golden age. Once the Royal Lords replaced the Council of Elders, Kourend prospered like never before.
Player
But that was a long time ago. Why does it matter now?
Artur Hosidius
Because I think it's time for another golden age. The Kourend Council, like the Council of Elders before them, have failed to do a good job in running this kingdom.
Player
And you think the five houses would do a better job?
Artur Hosidius
Exactly.
What makes you say the council have done a bad job?
Player
What makes you say the Council have done a bad job?
Artur Hosidius
More crime. Fewer homes. More illness. Loss of jobs. The list goes on.
Player
But aren't the five houses partially to blame as well? They rule the cities.
Artur Hosidius
The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.
Player
Hmmm, fair enough. Anyway, we'd better get off.
(End of dialogue)
Fair enough. See you later.
Player
Fair enough. See you later.
(End of dialogue)
Goodbye.
Player
Goodbye.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Why is the Accord important?
Artur Hosidius
The signing of the Accord marked the start of a golden age. Once the Royal Lords replaced the Council of Elders, Kourend prospered like never before.
Player
But that was a long time ago. Why does it matter now?
Artur Hosidius
Because I think it's time for another golden age. The Kourend Council, like the Council of Elders before them, have failed to do a good job in running this kingdom.
Player
And you think the five houses would do a better job?
Artur Hosidius
Exactly.
What makes you say the council have done a bad job?
Player
What makes you say the Council have done a bad job?
Artur Hosidius
More crime. Fewer homes. More illness. Loss of jobs. The list goes on.
Player
But aren't the five houses partially to blame as well? They rule the cities.
Artur Hosidius
The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.

Until next time

(End of dialogue)
Player
Hello there.
Asgarnia Smith
Hello again. You find any signs of that treasure yet?
Player

Player
Not as such, no. Sorry about that.
Asgarnia Smith

Asgarnia Smith
Maybe I'll go check out Karamja next, I hear there's treasure to be found there...
Tell me of your adventures
Player
I was wondering...
Player
As you are a big famous archaeologist, maybe you could spare the time to tell me a couple of tales of your exploits?
Asgarnia Smith
Hey, sure thing kid! Well, this one time I found this spooky old temple in the middle of the jungle.
Asgarnia Smith
The entrance was hidden from sight by all these vines and stuff, and it was full of zombies and crazy tribesmen and stuff.
Asgarnia Smith
That wasn't the worst thing though! There were all these crazy traps that were hidden around the place too!
Asgarnia Smith
Well anyway, I found the secret entrance, fought my way in through the zombies and tribesmen, and came to a big pedestal with a statue of solid gold sat on top of it!
Player
Solid gold, huh? Wow.
Asgarnia Smith
That's right! It was a cunning trap though! As soon as I picked up the statue, a trapdoor opened up underneath me, and I fell into a darkened room, full of
Asgarnia Smith
bones, and the biggest meanest tribesman you ever did see!
Asgarnia Smith
Huge he was, and real ugly looking! He had this huge sword too, and he came running towards me screaming something in some language I didn't understand!
Player
What did you do?
Asgarnia Smith
Well, while he was screaming at me, and swinging his sword around in front of me, trying to intimidate me before attacking, I cooly and calmly...
Player
Yes?
Asgarnia Smith
All the while, knowing that if I died in this spot nobody would even know where I was...
Player
What then?
Asgarnia Smith
I knew, if this tribesman killed me, that would be the end of Asgarnia Smith, and all of his treasure hunting...
Player
SO WHAT DID YOU DO?!?!
Asgarnia Smith
Well, while he was screaming and waving his sword around, I stood behind a nearby stalactite, then shot him with my shortbow.
Asgarnia Smith
And that was how I recovered the Golden Monkey of Tee-Ta-Toh.
(End of dialogue)
Tell me how you became an Archaeologist
Player
So... How exactly did you get into this line of work anyway?
Player
It seems an odd choice of career for a man like yourself.
Asgarnia Smith
Thinking of joining your pal Asgarnia in the wonderful world of treasure hun- um, archaeology, huh?
Asgarnia Smith
Well, it all started the day I was fishing in catherby[sic], funnily enough.
Asgarnia Smith
Ah yes, I remember it well... I was just sat there, hoping to catch a bass or two, when I made the most amazing discovery!
Asgarnia Smith
In my fishing nets, I had found an ancient casket, marred and worn by centuries underwater!
Asgarnia Smith
With trembling hands, I slowly and cautiously opened it, wondering what ancient secret may have been kept inside...
Asgarnia Smith
What valuable heirloom may have been dredged up by my nets that had not decayed underwater long ago...
Asgarnia Smith
And you know what I found inside?
Player
No, what?
Asgarnia Smith
I found 320 coins! Just like that! Just by fishing I had found 320 coins! 320 coins! Can you believe it?
Player
Um... Yes, yes I can.
Asgarnia Smith
Well, it might not seem much to us now kid, but back then, it was a revelation!
Asgarnia Smith
Why waste my time fishing when there were secret treasures from long ago hidden around the world?
Asgarnia Smith
I immediately applied to the Museum of Varrock as a field agent, and the rest is history!
(End of dialogue)
Nice hat!
Player
Nice hat!
Asgarnia Smith
Hey, thanks kid. Looking snazzy is an important part of being a treasure hunter!

Player
Hello? Who are you? What is this place?
Ashuelot Reis
I'm... Ashuelot... Ashuelot Reis. But I don't understand... How are you here?
Player
Oh... Well I'm [player name], and I'm here because I was told there was a great treasure to be found.
Ashuelot Reis
Treasure? I fear you have been misled. There is no treasure here, only our great mistake.
Player
Mistake?
Ashuelot Reis
This place is a prison. Here, a being of incomprehensible power was sealed away. Things would have stayed that way, if not for our foolishness.
Player
What happened?
Ashuelot Reis
We thought we were doing good, but we were led astray. We opened the prison, and unleashed the horror within.
Player
But the door was locked until I came along.
Ashuelot Reis
Yes... After our great mistake, four opposing armies united to contain the evil again. They managed to reseal the prison, but they were unable to repair the original enchantments.
Ashuelot Reis
This place has remained vulnerable ever since.
Player
And now I've opened it again.
Ashuelot Reis
If what you've told me is true, you were fooled just as we were. But I suppose that means little now. With the prison now open again, there isn't much to prevent the evil escaping once more.
Player
There must be something I can do to stop it.
Ashuelot Reis
There is only one thing you can do. You can fight.
Player
Then that is what I will do.
Player
Though, now that I think about it, I'm still not overly clear what this evil is.
Ashuelot Reis
She is a being of darkness. A servant of the Ruinous Powers. She is the Angel of Death. She is Nex.
Player
I'll stop her.
Ashuelot Reis
I hope so. Nex can be found in the inner section of the prison. Join me there. But be warned, Nex was not imprisoned alone. You'll need to fight through her followers to reach her.
Ashuelot Reis
Good luck.
Ashuelot Reis departs for the inner section of the prison.
Ashuelot Reis
You made it?
Player
You didn't think I would?
Ashuelot Reis
Nex's followers are capable of bringing down even the strongest of warriors. I did fear you might not make it past them.
Ashuelot Reis
Still, they are nothing compared to the Angel of Death herself.
Player
So how do I deal with her?
Ashuelot Reis
You will never be able to truly defeat her. The best you can do is to try and keep her contained. When you are ready to face her, just go through the barrier.
Ashuelot Reis
If it helps, while my magic is limited here, I should still be able to transfer items in and out of the prison for you. Let me know if you'd like me to do this before you enter.
Tell me more about Nex.
Player
Tell me more about Nex.
Ashuelot Reis
Long ago, these lands were dominated by a great empire, ruled over by an ancient god. The Empty Lord is what they often called him, but his true name was Zaros.
Player
Zaros? I've heard of him.
Ashuelot Reis
At the height of his power, Zaros seemed untouchable, but he was eventually defeated by those he trusted the most. With him gone, the empire collapsed. War broke out soon after.
Ashuelot Reis
Although their god was gone, many Zarosians fought to keep his empire alive. Among them was Nex. She was Zaros' most powerful weapon, and she led a great army to try and restore his empire.
Ashuelot Reis
Not that she needed an army of course. Nex alone was powerful enough to hold back hundreds of lesser beings.
Player
So how did she end up here?
Ashuelot Reis
The forces of Saradomin knew that Nex needed to be dealt with. They were able to lure her into these caverns.
Ashuelot Reis
After great effort and sacrifice, they managed to place Nex and her followers into a frozen, enchanted sleep.
Ashuelot Reis
Once Nex was no longer an immediate threat, they built the Temple of Lost Ancients around her. Most of the temple has since fallen to ruin, but you can still see some of the remains.
Player
But she wasn't frozen forever, was she? You said you were fooled into freeing her.
Ashuelot Reis
Yes. Later in the war, a great battle broke out in the Temple of Lost Ancients. I was a Saradominist soldier at the time, and I was among those who fought for him in that battle.
Ashuelot Reis
By then, many of us had grown tired of war. One of our priests discovered this. He came to us and revealed that he felt the same way, and that he had secretly converted to Guthix. He encouraged us to join him.
Ashuelot Reis
We abandoned the cause of Saradomin and became followers of Guthix. Our new leader taught us the ways of the druids, including an ancient ritual that had the power to awaken Guthix himself.
Ashuelot Reis
We believed this ritual to be the only way to end the war.
Player
But I'm guessing that's not how things went?
Ashuelot Reis
No... When our leader led us to perform the ritual, it was not Guthix we woke, but Nex and her forces. The ritual also destroyed the protective enchantments on their prison.
Player
And that was exactly what your leader wanted?
Ashuelot Reis
It was. He had never been a follower of Guthix, or Saradomin. His real goal had always been to free Nex.
Ashuelot Reis
The rest is as I already told you. Nex posed such a danger, that the four armies temorarily joined forces to drive her back into the prison. They resealed it, but were unable to fix the enchantments we destroyed.
Ashuelot Reis
As for me, I was one of the first to fall after Nex was freed, but I didn't truly die. Something about our ritual tied me to this place. I've been trapped here ever since. Not dead, but not really alive either.
Player
I'm sorry.
Ashuelot Reis
Don't be. This is the punishment for my sins.
Player
What of the one that led the ritual. What came of him?
Ashuelot Reis
He'd achieved his goal, so he left. I never saw him again.
Player
But who was he really?
Ashuelot Reis
He never gave us his true name, but as Nex was freed, she spoke to him.
Player
She knew him?
Ashuelot Reis
It seemed that way. I heard little of what they said, but I did hear what she called him.
Player
What was it?
Ashuelot Reis
Sliske.
Ashuelot Reis
Forgive me, but this conversation has brought back many memories. Let us speak no more of this.
Player
Of course.
(Shows other options)
Can I access my bank?
Player
Can I access my bank?
Ashuelot Reis
Of course.
bank interface opens
I'd like to collect some items.
Player
I'd like to collect some items.
Ashuelot Reis
Of course.
Grand Exchange collection opens
I need to go.
Player
I need to go.
Ashuelot Reis
Good luck out there.
(End of dialogue)

Player
Hello there.
Askeladden
Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh? I'm not really supposed to talk to you.
Player
Why not?
Askeladden
I dunno buddy. Some stupid tradition or other. We're always told not to talk to outerlanders unless the Chieftain has allowed it.
Player
The Chieftain? Who is that?
Askeladden
His names Brundt, buddy. He's a real boring guy. You can find him in the longhall there.
Player
Can you take me to see him?
Askeladden
Sorry buddy, I'm not allowed into the Longhall. Don't worry, he's easy to spot. He's the one in the fancy helmet. Oh, and he only has one eye.
Player
He's a cyclops?
Askeladden
Nah, nah, nah... He just wears an eyepatch! Well, see ya around buddy!
(End of dialogue)

Askeladden

Askeladden

Player

A pet ROCK!
Askeladden

Player
Hello Asteros. What brings you to the castle?
Asteros Arceuus
The King's late father asked for an advisor from Arceuus. He was keen for us to have a more central role than we did under the Council.
Player
I see. I'm sure the King is glad to have you here.
Asteros Arceuus
He does seem willing to take on my advice, which is very welcoming. I hope he remains humble. It is a trait many leaders lack.
Asteros Arceuus
Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can offer you the ability to respawn at Kourend Castle upon death.
Select an Option
Yes please.
Player
Yes please.
Asteros Arceuus
Very well. From now on, you will respawn at Kourend Castle.
(End of dialogue)
No thanks.
Player
No thanks.
Asteros Arceuus
Let me know if you change your mind.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Yes please.
Asteros Arceuus
Very well. From now on, you will respawn at Kourend Castle.
(End of dialogue)
Player
No thanks.
Asteros Arceuus
Let me know if you change your mind.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hello Asteros.

(Continues below)
Select an Option
Yes please.

Yes please.

(End of dialogue)
If the respawn point changes to Lumbridge
Asteros Arceuus
Very well. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
(End of dialogue)

Ava
Hello again. Are you after another device, or some information, or would you like to see my goods for sale?
Devices, please.
Player
Devices, please.
(Ava's Devices interface opens.)
I'd like information, please.
Player
I'd like information, please.
Ava
Just a few bits of information before you run away to persecute rock crabs or cows.
Ava
Firstly, your new device won't work if you are wearing certain metallic chest armours.
Ava
The magnetic attraction required for operation would cause feedback, so the device does not allow such incompatible item equip page.
Ava
Secondly, although the device is calibrated to attract only arrow heads, there is a chance that other magnetically active items will be attracted.
Ava
The arrow recovery function of the devices is slightly different and relies upon a harmonic bond between your arrows and the chicken's magnet. You'll thus only recover arrows which you have fired rather than those
Ava
fired by nearby folks.
Ava
You'll also need to move about if you want to collect arrows since the gathering of long-lost arrowheads can't work otherwise.
Ava
Finally, the device will only work when worn. It automatically deactivates in other circumstances.
Ava
I was worried about what would happen if you were to place it in a bank in its active state, so I've made sure it only works when it's on your back.
(End of dialogue)

(Transcript missing?- Unknown condition edit)
Baba Yaga
Hmm, actually, I think I had better go further back, so you will understand.
Baba Yaga
You know of our ancient war with the Fremennik that you recently healed?
Player
Of course! I am a great diplomat, aren't I?
Baba Yaga
Some diplomat. Did you even discover WHY we were at war for so long?
Player
Errr... You couldn't see eye to eye about magic, or something like that.
Baba Yaga
Not too far off
Baba Yaga
The Fremennik were actually the first to discover how to make runes, but there was disagreement within the tribe about the implications of making such powerful objects.
Baba Yaga
Most Fremennik felt we were stealing power from the gods. They could not see past that to the great things we could do with such power, so we split from them and became the Moon Clan. Our ancient leader, who first
Baba Yaga
discovered the rune essence mine here on Lunar Isle, travelled far and wide searching for more places of power. He and his followers built altars all over Gielinor - which you use today to create runes - and at their
Baba Yaga
height they made runes by the crateful. They had perfected the process and even advanced it, creating altars that could create any type of rune regardless of the crafter's ability. But the strife between the Moon
Baba Yaga
Clan and the Fremennik heightened. The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown stong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we had lived ever since.
Baba Yaga
The Fremennik then swept over Gielinor destroying the altars we had made, in an attempt to remove all trace of magic from the land.
Player
That's all very interesting, but what's it got to do with this spell?
Baba Yaga
I'm getting to that!
Baba Yaga
The Fremennik were not as thorough as they thought. They destroyed only the entrances to the altars, for the altars themselves were on a different plane, but they were successful in wiping out our ability to create
Baba Yaga
runes. That ability has only recently been rediscovered on the mainland, so I hear.
Baba Yaga
Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to out advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory. Fortunately,
Baba Yaga
some records survived... The manuscript I discovered contains the teleportation spell to an advanced altar called Ourania. It's an altar that allows the user, regardless of their Runecrafting ability, to craft any
Baba Yaga
type of rune upon it. Ourania is a powerful altar indeed. What state it is in after so many millennia, I know not, but it's interesting all the same.
Player
So, will you teach me the spell?
Baba Yaga
Certainly.
Baba Yaga
*Baby Yaga whispers in your ear*
Baba Yaga

Clan and the Fremennik heightened. The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown stong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we had lived ever since.
Baba Yaga
The Fremennik then swept over Gielinor destroying the altars we had made, in an attempt to remove all trace of magic from the land.
Player
That's all very interesting, but what's it got to do with this spell?
Baba Yaga
I'm getting to that!
Baba Yaga
The Fremennik were not as thorough as they thought. They destroyed only the entrances to the altars, for the altars themselves were on a different plane, but they were successful in wiping out our ability to create
Baba Yaga
runes. That ability has only recently been rediscovered on the mainland, so I hear.
Baba Yaga
Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to out advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory. Fortunately,
Baba Yaga
some records survived... The manuscript I discovered contains the teleportation spell to an advanced altar called Ourania. It's an altar that allows the user, regardless of their Runecrafting ability, to craft any
Baba Yaga
type of rune upon it. Ourania is a powerful altar indeed. What state it is in after so many millennia, I know not, but it's interesting all the same.
Player
So, will you teach me the spell?
Baba Yaga
Certainly.
Baba Yaga
*Baby Yaga whispers in your ear*
Baba Yaga
And now you know the teleportation spell, off with you! Go explore.
(End of dialogue)
Baba Yaga
Hmm, actually, I think I had better go further back, so you will understand.
Player
I don't really have ti-
Baba Yaga
*Sigh* Very well. Another time, perhaps.
Player
Why do you ask questions if you're going to read my mind anyway?
Baba Yaga
I was being polite, silly foreigner.
(End of dialogue)
Player
I'm good thanks, bye.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hello there.
Baba Yaga
Ah, a stranger to our island. What brings you here?
Player
The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help...
Baba Yaga
With a potion?
Player
I don't think I'll ever get used to you people reading my mind. Yes, a potion of Waking Sleep? I need it to go to the...
Baba Yaga
Dreamland.
Player
You know that's really quite rude!
Baba Yaga
Sorry. Carry on.
Player
Well, I was hoping you could tell me how to make one?
Baba Yaga
Of course.
Baba Yaga
Are you sure you're ready to take on the dream land?
Player
There's no harm in trying. Right...?
Baba Yaga
Well, some people have gone mad from visiting their dreams.
Player
You really know how to instil discomfort don't you!?! How do you make...
Baba Yaga
You'll need 1 guam leaf, 1 Marrentill leaf and a Suqah tooth ground using a pestle and mortar. Combine these in a vial and BAM! You've got your potion! You should be able to get the ingredients from the
Baba Yaga
Suqah monsters.
Baba Yaga
You'll also need a special vial, I have one here.
Player
Thanks.
(End of dialogue)

Player

Good day, how may I help you?
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
(Bank interface opens.)
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
(Bank PIN interface opens.)
I'd like to collect items.
(Grand Exchange collection interface opens.)
What is this place?
Player
What is this place?
Banker
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
Player
And what do you do?
Banker
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
(End of dialogue)
(Bank interface opens.)

Banker
Welcome to the Sophanem Bank! Anything I can help you with?
Select an Option
Are you with the Bank of Gielinor?
Player
Are you with the Bank of Gielinor?
Banker
We have an agreement with them, yes. It took some time to work out.
Banker
As you may have noticed, the desert adds complications to all matters of trade and finance.
Banker
Was there something else you wanted?
(Shows other options)
How is business?
Player
How is business?
Banker
It could be better. The businesses here are still recovering from recent events. Personal banking like yours makes up the majority of our trade.
Banker
Was there anything else with which I can help you?
(Shows other options)
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
(Bank interface opens.)
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
(Bank PIN interface opens.)
I'd like to collect items, please.
(Grand Exchange collection box interface opens.)
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
Player
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
If the player is an Ultimate Ironman
Banker
Why? You don't use the bank.
Player
Oh yeah... Never mind then.
(End of dialogue)
Banker
I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
(Bank space purchase interface opens.)
Player
[number] slots please.
Banker
Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
Yes.
Player
Yes, I'm happy with that.
Banker
Your additional bank slots have been added.
(End of dialogue)
No.
Player
Actually, I've changed my mind.
(End of dialogue)

Banker tutor
Good day, how may I help you?
How do I use the bank?
Using the bank itself.
Player
Using the bank itself. I'm not sure how....?
Banker tutor
Speak to any banker and ask to see your bank account. If you have set a PIN you will be asked for it, then all the belongings you have placed in the bank will appear in the window. To withdraw one item, left-
Banker tutor
click on it once.
Banker tutor
To withdraw many, right-click on the item and select from the menu. The same for depositing, left-click on the item in your inventory to deposit it in the bank. Right-click on it to deposit many of the same items.
Banker tutor
To move things around in your bank
firstly select Swap or Insert as your default moving mode, you can find these buttons on the bank window itself. Then click and drag an item to where you want it to appear.
Banker tutor
You may withdraw 'notes' or 'certificates' when the items you are trying to withdraw do not stack in your inventory. This will only work for items which are tradable.
Banker tutor
For instance, if you wanted to sell 100 logs to another player, they would not fit in one inventory and you would need to do multiple trades. Instead, click the Note button to do withdraw the logs as 'certs' or 'notes',
Banker tutor
then withdraw the items you need.
Using Bank deposit boxes.
Player
Using Bank deposit boxes.... what are they?
Banker tutor
They look like grey pillars, there's one just over there, near the desk. Bank deposit boxes save so much time. If you're simply wanting to deposit a single item, 'Use' it on the deposit box.
Banker tutor
Otherwise, simply click once on the box and it will give you a choice of what to deposit in an interface very similar to the bank itself. Very quick for when you're simply fishing or mining etc.
What's this PIN thing that people keep talking about?
Player
What's this PIN thing that people keep talking about?
Banker tutor
The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect the items there in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember and tell
Banker tutor
no one.
Banker tutor
So if someone did manage to get your password they couldn't steal your items if they were in the bank.
How do I set my PIN?
Player
How do I set my PIN?
Banker tutor
You can set your PIN by talking to any banker, they will allow you to access your bank pin settings. Here you can choose to set your pin and recovery delay. Remember not to set it to anything personal such as
Banker tutor
your real life bank PIN or birthday.
Banker tutor
The recovery delay is to protect your banked items from account thieves. If someone stole your account and asked to have the PIN deleted, they would have to wait a few days before accessing your bank account to
Banker tutor
steal your items. This will give you time to recover your account.
Banker tutor
There will also be a delay in actually setting the PIN to be used, this is so that if your account is stolen and a PIN set, you can cancel it before it comes into use!
How do I remove my PIN?
Player
How do I remove my PIN?
Banker tutor
Talking to any banker will enable you to access your PIN settings. There you can cancel or change your PIN, but you will need to wait for your recovery delay to expire to be able to access your bank. This
Banker tutor
can be set in the settings page and will protect your items should your account be stolen.
What happens if I forget my PIN?
Player
What happens if I forget my PIN?
Banker tutor
If you find yourself faced with the PIN keypad and you don't know the PIN, just look on the right-hand side for a button marked 'I don't know it'. Click this button. Your PIN will be deleted (after a delay of a
Banker tutor
few days) and you'll be able to use your bank as before. You may still use the bank deposit box without your PIN.
I know about the PIN, tell me about the bank.
(Shows previous options)
Goodbye.
Player
Goodbye.
(End of dialogue)

The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect the items there in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember and tell
Banker tutor
no one.
Banker tutor
So if someone did manage to get your password they couldn't steal your items if they were in the bank.
How do I set my PIN?
Player
How do I set my PIN?
Banker tutor
You can set your PIN by talking to any banker, they will allow you to access your bank pin settings. Here you can choose to set your pin and recovery delay. Remember not to set it to anything personal such as
Banker tutor
your real life bank PIN or birthday.
Banker tutor
The recovery delay is to protect your banked items from account thieves. If someone stole your account and asked to have the PIN deleted, they would have to wait a few days before accessing your bank account to
Banker tutor
steal your items. This will give you time to recover your account.
Banker tutor
There will also be a delay in actually setting the PIN to be used, this is so that if your account is stolen and a PIN set, you can cancel it before it comes into use!
How do I remove my PIN?
Player
How do I remove my PIN?
Banker tutor
Talking to any banker will enable you to access your PIN settings. There you can cancel or change your PIN, but you will need to wait for your recovery delay to expire to be able to access your bank. This
Banker tutor
can be set in the settings page and will protect your items should your account be stolen.
What happens if I forget my PIN?
Player
What happens if I forget my PIN?
Banker tutor
If you find yourself faced with the PIN keypad and you don't know the PIN, just look on the right-hand side for a button marked 'I don't know it'. Click this button. Your PIN will be deleted (after a delay of a
Banker tutor
few days) and you'll be able to use your bank as before. You may still use the bank deposit box without your PIN.
I know about the PIN, tell me about the bank.
(Shows previous options)
Goodbye.

Goodbye.
(End of dialogue)
